confidence_notes: Restaurant and coffee anchors rest on sparse, partly dated aggregator and comparison-site figures, with an approximate rupee-to-dollar basis near 88 INR per USD. Beer is a bounded estimate from bar-markup reasoning because no pub or bar menu prices were found. Cocktail and wine are derived from the local beer relationship, since direct evidence was weak. Hostel and hotel anchors are holistic model estimates from general knowledge and the city context, with no live listings inspected. The RBA rate was taken from a search-result summary of the RBA exchange-rates listing and was not verified by opening the RBA page directly. Sources citing Hyderabad, Pakistan were excluded.
comparable_city_reasoning: No close international comparable. Anchored to the broader Indian urban market (tier-1 cities such as Bengaluru and Pune) and adjusted to Hyderabad's mid-range pricing. Telangana's relatively high alcohol taxes were used to set bar drink prices above retail.
